title: LINZ Data Service imagery accessed through QGIS WMTS
sourceName: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand
credit: Source: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand, licensed for re-use under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Web display copy resized and converted to WebP.
altText: QGIS with a connected LINZ map-tile service in a public-data tutorial.
caption: QGIS used with the LINZ Data Service WMTS connection, showing the workflow through which downloadable public geospatial information can be served as map layers.
dateDisplay: LINZ user-guide screenshot; precise capture date not established
context: A screenshot from LINZ's public WMTS guidance. It documents software access to open spatial data and is not an image of the earliest version of the LINZ Data Service.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
